component.name: Teral
component.summary: Browse and manage files on Linux

description.p: Teral is a native GTK4 file manager with a compact three-pane interface for locations, files, and immediate details.
It integrates with Linux file associations, system icon themes, removable devices, the FreeDesktop trash, and Omarchy appearance settings.
Adds compact overlay drawers, improves Wayland bookmark dragging, and removes continuous responsive-layout frame polling while the application is idle.
Adds an adaptive one-pane workspace for narrow tiled windows and keeps the title-bar close-button hover treatment compact across desktop themes.
Adds verified command-line updates, responsive details actions, clean shutdown, and system appearance as the default for new configurations.
